Not built
Proof-of-concept reporting layer over the central QA pipeline — worst-of status rollup, Agency → Data Collection → Dataset → Column. Registry Services → Civil Registration → Birth Registrations is real: its figures are computed by running the actual dbt-core, Soda Core, datacontract-cli, and Evidently AI binaries against real generated pipeline runs. The Department for Child Protection and Family Support → Child Protection collection (all 6 datasets) is also real, computed the same way — including cross-table foreign-key and business-rule checks, not just single-column rules. Every dataset on this page is real — the illustrative mock datasets that used to sit alongside them were removed on 2026-09-23.

Internal project codename: Mothman.

Cadence-aware viewing

View data asset as of a date

Rolls every real dataset back to whichever of its own QA runs was the most recent at or before the date you pick — showing exactly what was actually known as of that date, not just filtering what's on screen now. A dataset with no run yet as of that date shows as No data, never a misleading blank, green, or red. Applies to the whole data asset at once.
